name: stumps_y11s_1280
purpose: stumps detector for calibration seeding (Acme IND v ZIM, split by match time)
warning: Validation metrics only; evaluate on a held-out test split (scripts/evaluate_detector.py) and on real target footage before use.
license_note: Fine-tuned from Ultralytics YOLO11s (AGPL-3.0); labels from Acme AI Cricket Semantic Segmentation (CC BY 4.0).
training_data: Acme AI stumps masks -> boxes, IND v ZIM 2022, one match. Split by match time: frames <=175 train (130 boxes), 176-260 val (81), >=261 test (73).

auto_calibration_on_other_matches.note: With the pair-geometry and camera-plausibility checks, all 3 calibrations project the creases onto the painted creases; 37 are refused, mostly because the near wicket is occluded or not detected. Before the checks, 2 of 6 accepted calibrations were false.

use: Seeds camera calibration (scripts/calibrate_cameras.py auto). Output is never marked validated.
known_limitations: Trained on a single match; other grounds, kits and stump colours are untested beyond 40 clips
Recall 0.58; both wickets found in only 7/18 two-wicket test frames
Box edges: median 1.4 px, p90 7 px error on the test frames; synthetic benchmark shows 2 px edge noise gives ~13 cm median / ~32 cm p90 ground error
The near wicket is often hidden by the umpire or bowler in delivery views
